question: Which letter and accompanying elements are specified in this part of the sequence?
premises: The letter ka in the ṣṭāli-triad is specified.
The element eyayau is included likewise.
inference: The sequence includes the ṣṭāli-triad ga-letter, ādada, and eyayau.
uncertainties: The meaning of ṣṭāli+traya is unclear.
ādadaś and eyayau appear to be mantra syllables or technical forms.
plain_english: The ga-letter of the ṣṭāli-triad, ādada, and likewise eyayau are included.
